value: 2026-09-03: SUPERSEDED into codemother — mutation testing for agreement checks becomes a capability of the codemother device (the watcher face), not a standalone voyage. The harness, the declaration requirement, and the WATCHME probe spec all transfer. Akien: the code-watching role is driven by inference_proxy, not Claude.

value.a: THE ESTABLISHED NAME IS MUTATION TESTING, and it is called that here. Build-to-the-tool naming: a term must be derivable from its native-domain use, and nobody should have to memorise a local synonym for a known technique. Naming it correctly also carries information — it means the shape is known-good rather than a local guess.

THE TWO MUTATIONS ARE NOT INTERCHANGEABLE, and this is the finding worth the ticket. If mutating side A reds and mutating side B does not, the check is a one-input check wearing an agreement check's clothes — precisely the shape this session set out to eliminate. That diagnosis is more valuable than the pass/fail, and it is only available because the mutation set is exactly two.

MUTATE THE INPUTS, NOT THE CHECKER. Mutating the checker tests the harness. It is the easy wrong version and is written into the falsifier because it would look like working code and produce confident, meaningless greens.

AN UNMUTATABLE INPUT IS RECORDED, NEVER SKIPPED. A silent skip lets coverage read as total while the covered set shrinks — the same no-data-is-not-a-pass shape that runs through the whole corrosion program.
